column1: # Per-reading settings for POL-028 splits (pol028.py). One row per (record, reading); records with no row use the defaults:
# base = the reading WITHOUT the optional morpheme, keeps the published id; '-opt' = the reading WITH it; both carry the record's
# translations. 'takes' = which reading this sentence is (with|without). sentence_text overrides the text when NTU's sentence line
# does not mark the option. zho/eng replace that language's translation ('-' = none). notes go on the original-tier FORM.
